steps.speaker: Liaison Officer
steps.content: Target Sinner is moving toward the northeast of the villa where her partners are. All sheriffs in the Villa, intercept her with all you've got.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: But... But our job is just to protect that mansion and that woman.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: The MBCC arrest team are still here, aren't they? I know they haven't gone far. They're standing by right outside the villa. You should let them handle this!

steps.speaker: Liaison Officer
steps.content: Your job is to capture this frail Sinner in the villa. Don't let her escape and don't let her die.
He's cut off. On the other end of the flower trail, that manic monster is charging at him. Immense fear wrecks the sheriff's sanity like a howling tempest.
